title: achhe mere baba
body:
achhe mere baba
haaye kya aalame tanhaayi hai
jab aakhri rukhsat ko chale sayyade waala
kohraam tha dil hote the gham se taho baala
shabbir ne godi se sakina ko utaara
ghaazi ko kabhi akbar o qaasim ko pukaara
baba ko qasam deke bulaati thi sakina
sar pitti piche se chali jaati thi sakina
achhe mere baba haaye kya aalame tanhaayi hai
achhe mere baba na sakina se chupaana
